scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present typecheck && pnpm --filter @mcet/web exec tsc -p ../mobile/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: pnpm test:schemas && pnpm --filter @mcet/i18n test && pnpm --filter @mcet/api test && pnpm --filter @mcet/web test
scripts.test:backend:unit: pnpm test:schemas && pnpm --filter @mcet/api test && pnpm test:calendar:unit
scripts.test:db: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @mcet/api exec vitest run --config vitest.database.config.ts && go -C services/calendar test -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/outbox
scripts.test:mobile: node scripts/test-bdd.mjs android ios android-tablet ios-tablet
scripts.test:native:mobile: node scripts/test-native-mobile.mjs android ios android-tablet ios-tablet
scripts.test:ci: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:calendar:unit && pnpm test:behavior
scripts.test:all: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:calendar:unit && pnpm test:db && pnpm test:behavior && pnpm test:mobile
scripts.test:env:up: docker compose -f compose.prod.yml -f compose.ci.yml --env-file .env.ci -p mcet-tests up -d --build --wait
scripts.test:env:down: docker compose -f compose.prod.yml -f compose.ci.yml --env-file .env.ci -p mcet-tests down
